question_text: Fill in: 'The project will proceed, ___ the budget is approved.'

hint_ladder.title: Meaning ng Sentence
hint_ladder.text: Sabi ng sentence: Tuloy ang proyekto basta approved ang budget. Kailangan ng tamang connector na nagpapakita ng kondisyon.

hint_ladder.title: 'Provided that' = Condition
hint_ladder.text: 'Provided that' ay 'sa kondisyon na...' — ginagamit kapag may kinakailangang mangyari bago matuloy ang isang bagay.

hint_ladder.title: Tingnan ang iba
hint_ladder.text: 'Unless' = 'kung hindi' (baligtad). 'Although'/'despite' = contrast, hindi condition. Mali sila kasi hindi match sa kailangan ng sentence.

hint_ladder.title: Sagot
hint_ladder.text: Tamang sagot: 'provided that' — ito lang ang nagbibigay ng tamang kondisyon para matuloy ang proyekto. Simple pero dahilan.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'unless' seems like a condition, but it flips the meaning to 'if not' — opposite of what’s intended.

B.text: Correct. 'Provided that' precisely states the condition that the budget must be approved for the project to proceed.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 'although' is a common connector, but it introduces contrast, not a necessary condition.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'despite' sounds possible, but it’s a preposition needing a noun phrase, not a full clause.

next_time_rule: Tandaan: 'provided that' = kondisyon, 'unless' = kung hindi, 'although'/'despite' = contrast. Kapag may hinihinging requirement, 'provided that' ang sagot.
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay hall, inaabangan mo ang road project. Sabi ng kapitan, ‘Tuloy ang kalsada provided that may budget ang LGU.’ Ibig sabihin, kailangan munang aprubahan ang pondo bago mag-umpisa. ‘Provided that’ ang nagbibigay ng tamang kondisyon.

‘Unless’ naman ay baliktad: ‘Tutuloy maliban kung walang budget’ — ibig sabihin titigil lang kung wala, mali. ‘Although’ at ‘despite’ ay ginagamit sa pagkontra, hindi sa kondisyon; halimbawa, ‘although walang budget’ ay hindi akma.

Kaya sa tanong, ‘The project will proceed, ___ the budget is approved,’ ang tanging salitang nagpapahayag ng kinakailangan bago umusad ay ‘provided that.’ Mali ang iba dahil binabago nila ang lohika o gramatika ng pangungusap.
